logo:

Asset type: production-ready transparent bilingual brand logo
Primary request: Create a distinctive logo for Rakkib, an AI workflow integration company. Symbol: visible interlocking modules with exact fit; two compact teal components joined by one coral connector, clever negative-space R, engineered but warm. Pair symbol with bilingual wordmark.
Style/medium: crisp vector-like flat identity, custom geometric sans Latin and clean modern Arabic lettering.
Color palette: teal #087E7A, coral #EF745C, dark ink #153F42.
Text (verbatim): "Rakkib" and "ركّب"
Composition: wide horizontal lockup, generous clear space, transparent background.
Constraints: exact spelling including Arabic shadda; one coherent mark, scalable, legible, no mockup, no extra copy.
